Author: liunianhui
Description:

[/color][color=#00ff00]这是一个坐落在山顶的农场，超大的天空背景，农场下方有一个很大的月亮湖
还许多瀑布景观
矿车分布在农场各个区域，需要修复社区中心锅炉房解锁
开局在农场洞穴门口会有一颗樱桃树
农舍右下方有一个祝尼魔，每天可以点击一次，有几率获得五彩碎片
每天生成6个硬木桩，可以在配置中取消
默认替换标准农场，也可以在配置中修改
This is a farm on the summit, with a huge sky background and a large Moon Lake below the farm.
There are also many waterfall attractions.
Mine cars are distributed in various areas of the farm, and can be used after repairing the boiler room in the community center.
There will be a cherry tree at the entrance of the farm cave.
There is a Junimo located at the bottom right of the farmhouse, which can be clicked once a day and has a chance to obtain Prismatic Shard.
Generate 6 stumps every day, which can be disabled in the config.
Default replacement of standard farm, can also be modified in the config.[/color]
